title: Robot waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <rect x='32' y='52' width='36' height='32' rx='8' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
  <rect x='38' y='62' width='24' height='12' rx='3' fill='#B3E5FC'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='68' r='2' fill='#FF7043'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='68' r='2' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='68' r='2' fill='#81C784'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <rect x='28' y='14' width='44' height='34' rx='9' fill='#29B6F6'/>
  <!-- Screen -->
  <rect x='33' y='19' width='34' height='24' rx='5' fill='#1B2A4A'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='29' r='4' fill='#7CFC9A'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='29' r='4' fill='#7CFC9A'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='29' r='1.6' fill='#E8FFF0'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='29' r='1.6' fill='#E8FFF0'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M43 36 Q50 41 57 36' stroke='#7CFC9A' stroke-width='2.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Antenna -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='8' width='3' height='7' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='7' r='3.5' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  <!-- Left arm (down) -->
  <rect x='22' y='56' width='10' height='6' rx='3' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='65' r='5' fill='#FFB74D'/>
  <!-- Right arm (waving up) -->
  <rect x='64' y='46' width='8' height='14' rx='4' fill='#4FC3F7' transform='rotate(25 68 52)'/>
  <circle cx='79' cy='42' r='6' fill='#FFB74D'/>
  <!-- Waving motion lines -->
  <path d='M87 36 Q90 40 87 44' stroke='#FFD54F' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M91 32 Q95 40 91 48' stroke='#FFD54F' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='38' y='84' width='8' height='8' rx='3' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
  <rect x='54' y='84' width='8' height='8' rx='3' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <rect x='35' y='90' width='14' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#FF7043'/>
  <rect x='51' y='90' width='14' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#FF7043'/>
</svg>
